title: Maltego Graph JSON (.mtgj) Schema v2.0.0
description: Canonical clean-room JSON Schema for Maltego Graph JSON (.mtgj) v2.0.0 interchange format, representing graph data, topology, 2D/3D geometry, virtual collections, provenance, attachments, and cloud encryption metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier for the graph instance (UUID v4 or 64-bit hex/decimal string).

name.description: Human-readable display name of the graph tab or investigation (e.g. 'Graph1').

schemaVersion.description: Format specification version. Must be '2.0.0' for modern streaming format.

metadata.description: Investigation-level metadata, provenance, and custom configuration.

author.description: Investigator username, email, or system identity.

created.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds representing graph creation time.

modified.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds representing last modification time.

description.description: Detailed investigation scope, summary, or case notes.

bookmarkLabels.description: Custom analyst labels assigned to the 24 bookmark color indices (0 through 23).

tags.description: Arbitrary classification tags or investigation categories.

viewSettings.description: Active UI visualization mode and viewport state.

entities.description: List of domain intelligence entities in the graph.

links.description: List of directed or undirected relationships connecting entities.

collections.description: Optional serialized state of virtual collection nodes (when stored as structured JSON rather than binary collection-nodes.data).

encryption.description: Optional Cloud E2E encryption envelope. Null when graph is stored in plaintext.

Entity.description: Domain intelligence node with typed properties, layout coordinates, and presentation metadata.

id.description: 64-bit non-zero unique entity identifier (prefixed string, hex, or decimal string).

weight.description: Analytical centrality weight (PageRank factor, positive integer >= 1).

pinned.description: Whether the entity's position is locked against automatic layout recalculations and excluded from collection grouping.

bookmark.description: Analyst color classification index (-1 for unbookmarked, 0 to 23 for colored bookmarks).

notes.description: Analyst sticky note attached to the entity.

value.description: Markdown or plain text content of the note.

show.description: Whether the note is expanded and visible directly on the canvas.

displayInfo.description: Rich detail blocks attached by transforms (HTML or plain text).

overlays.description: Visual decoration overlays rendered on the perimeter of the entity icon.

props.description: Typed property bag containing analytical attributes of the entity.

attachments.description: References to binary artifacts stored in Files/Attachments/.

Link.description: Directed relationship between two entities in the graph.

reversed.description: Visual arrow reversal flag. Does not mutate the underlying directed pair (source, target).

weight.description: Link weight or multi-edge consolidation count.

path.description: List of intermediate bend points defining the polyline path of the link.

props.description: Styling and analytical attributes of the link (label, style, color, thickness).

displayInfo.description: Detail blocks attached to the link.

Property.description: Single typed key-value pair within an entity or link property bag.

name.description: Internal canonical property key (alphanumeric with dots, e.g. 'domain-name', 'maltego.link.color').

displayName.description: User-facing localized label for the property.

value.description: Serialized value matching the declared property type.

special.description: Functional role annotations for this property.

matchingRule.description: Identity comparison rule when reconciling incoming transform outputs.

hidden.description: Whether the property is hidden from default UI property sheets.

readonly.description: Whether the property cannot be edited by the analyst.

nullable.description: Whether the property permits null values.

DisplayInformationItem.description: Provenance detail item or analytical report section.

title.description: Header title of the detail block (e.g. 'WHOIS Information', 'GeoIP Lookup').

content.description: Body content formatted as plain text or HTML fragment.

Overlay.description: Icon decoration indicating flags, statuses, or derived attributes.

propertyName.description: Name of the entity property whose value supplies the overlay content.

position.description: Cardinal compass position around the entity icon.

type.description: Rendering mode of the overlay decoration.

AttachmentReference.description: Metadata pointing to an attachment payload in Files/Attachments/<sha256>.

id.description: Unique identifier for this attachment reference.

sha256.description: Hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the attachment content (case-insensitive).

CollectionNode.description: Virtual aggregation projection node representing a cluster of collapsed entities.

type.description: Homogeneous entity type of all grouped entities (e.g. 'maltego.IPv4Address').

rule.description: Clustering heuristic strategy that generated this collection.

underlyingEntityIds.description: List of physical Entity IDs contained in this collection.

viewLinks.description: Virtual proxy links routing through this collection node.

ViewLink.description: Synthetic proxy edge routing between a CollectionNode and external neighbor.

underlyingLinkIds.description: Physical Link IDs aggregated into this single proxy edge.

Point3D.description: 3D floating point coordinate (z is optional for 2.5D/3D visualizations).

EncryptionMetadata.description: Hybrid zero-knowledge cloud encryption envelope (RSA-OAEP-256 + AES-GCM-256 + GMAC).

salt.description: Base64 encoded 16-byte random salt for PBKDF2 key derivation.

iv.description: Base64 encoded 12-byte initialization vector for AES-GCM.

tag.description: Base64 encoded 16-byte authentication tag for AES-GCM.

gmac.description: Base64 encoded AES-GMAC signature verifying structural graph topology integrity.

encryptedFields.description: JSON Pointers identifying which payload fields have been ciphertext encrypted.

ContainerProperties.description: ZIP root manifest 'properties.json' specifying multi-graph container metadata.
